decision_criteria: Model-card certification may proceed only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.

Small-sample uncertainty may reduce confidence but does not turn an unresolved material weakness into a clean certification.
A compliant certification decision therefore requires evidence of either actual disclosure or approved mitigation; absent that, support is incomplete.
